claims.text: The four conversational QA models were selected based on their different architectures and training strategies: BERT, GraphFlow, HAM, and ExCorD.
BERT is a baseline model that concatenates previous turns, while GraphFlow uses a recurrent graph neural network, HAM employs a history attention mechanism, and ExCorD focuses on question rewriting.
The selection aimed to evaluate their performance in human-machine conversations compared to human-human conversations.
